images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable blockbuster frame. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. At an ancient desert temple threshold connected by a cosmic portal rupture to a pirate flagship at dusk, the Amazonian warrior protector hero makes a sudden backward recoil as a miniature evacuation bus flies safely upward around him. Gravity reverses only around the protagonist: sand, ropes, and harmless debris float while his paws remain grounded. A near-touching paw homage composition points toward a frightened apparent villain inside the bus. Event is the portal rupture; outcome is the apparent villain becomes the rescue target. Include chaotic excited open-mouth face, sudden backward recoil, miniature evacuation bus, one decisive action, rain-soaked, dark, weighty cinematic tone, no franchise insignia, safe staged VFX, no logos, no text, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no animal distress, no malformed anatomy.
Required assigned visual details: battlefield rescue; no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
